updates.title: No stay-to-play policy published — re-checked September 18
updates.description: We checked the official tournament page, the SCUFC host site and the registration portal again on September 18, 2026 and still found no housing requirement or approved-hotel list for the Carolina Cup. Our picks are simply the closest options with confirmed availability — there is no housing portal to book through. We have asked tournament director Tripp Miller to confirm.

This is the one item that cannot be handled at the field. Re-verified September 18, 2026.

updates.title: 2026 rules document still not published — re-checked September 18

breakPlan.title: Between-Games Rhythm
breakPlan.intro: Saturday is a 10:30 AM and 3:30 PM double. The match runs about 65 minutes, so you have roughly 3 hours free in between at the same complex — enough to eat properly and cool down without leaving the area.

steps.label: Cool down + shade
steps.note: Ballentine has shade near the parking side. Change socks and shirts now, not later.

steps.label: Real lunch, real sitting
steps.note: Eat within 30 minutes of the whistle while muscles are still warm — a proper meal, not snacks. Anywhere in Irmo/Ballentine; the Irmo cluster is 5-10 minutes away.

steps.label: Quiet hour
steps.note: Shade, feet up, screens down. A 30-45 minute rest in the car with A/C does more for a 9-year-old than any drill.

steps.label: Rehydrate + light warm-up
steps.note: Water and electrolytes sipped steadily from 1:00 PM — not a bottle all at once.

steps.label: Back for game #706
steps.note: Field 2B. Parking is busiest about 30 minutes before kickoff.
